description: This file implements a custom Android SpellCheckerService named SampleSpellCheckerService with an inner class AndroidSpellCheckerSession. It provides methods for generating spelling suggestions and sentence-level suggestions, with mocked logic for demonstration purposes.

classes.name: SampleSpellCheckerService
classes.description: Main service class extending SpellCheckerService, responsible for creating spell checker sessions.

classes.name: AndroidSpellCheckerSession
classes.description: Inner class extending SpellCheckerService.Session, implementing suggestion algorithms and sentence suggestions.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates and returns a new spell checker session, specifically an AndroidSpellCheckerSession instance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes session state, notably setting the locale.

methods.name: onGetSuggestions
methods.description: Provides spelling suggestions for a given TextInfo, using mocked logic based on input length.

methods.name: onGetSentenceSuggestionsMultiple
methods.description: Delivers sentence-level suggestions; returns predefined corrections for a specific sentence, or generic suggestions otherwise.

methods.name: isSentenceSpellCheckApiSupported
methods.description: Checks if the API for sentence-level spell checks is supported based on Android SDK version.
